title: GPT-5.5 is OpenAI’s most capable agentic AI model yet
summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5.5 on April 23 as a new class of agentic AI model designed specifically for autonomous task execution, featuring built-in capabilities for planning, tool usage, self-verification, and independent problem-solving.
problem_solved: Enables AI agents to autonomously handle complex multi-step tasks without requiring constant human supervision or intervention.
why_valuable: Provides the most capable agentic AI model to date, allowing businesses to build more sophisticated autonomous workflows and AI agents for real-world applications.
